<b>A Lifesaving Bridge</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on [[Bone Bottom]]'s [[wishwall]] after [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] completes the <i>[[Bone Bottom Repairs]]</i> wish and either defeats [[Widow]] or enters [[Greymoor]].

== Wish ==
To complete the wish, donate {{S|300}} to Bone Bottom's wishwall.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Wishwall.png!Location of Bone Bottom's wishwall
}}

== Reward ==
Once the wish is completed and the game is [[Save Data (Silksong)/Save Points|saved]] outside the room where the settlement is located (with the [[Bellway]] station considered as part of the settlement), a bridge is constructed over the hole leading to the [[Moss Grotto]].

The bridge is safe to cross but takes damage if attacked, jumped on, or headbutted from below. It withstands up to four impacts, with each hit causing a cracking sound and making the structure sag down, but is instantly destroyed if Hornet falls on it from a great height or down-dashes into it. If the bridge is only partially damaged, it returns to full strength when Hornet moves to a different room or the game reloads.

The bridge is destroyed with the rest of the settlement at the start of [[Act 3]].
